c3-code-lab-predict: Read the program. Choose what it prints before you run it. A wrong choice is crossed out. Your work stays here, and there is no timer.
c3-code-lab-build: Tap a blank line, then choose a value or expression. Run checks your whole program. Undo takes back an edit. Look, One step, and Clear help you follow the real program.
c3-code-lab-return: Return sends a value back to the place that called a function. Lines after that return do not run on that call.
c3-code-lab-list: A list keeps values in order. Position zero is the first value. Append puts one more value at the end.
